description:
Override one voice block's voice or playback volume (block ids from
    list_voice_blocks). Re-run generate_voiceover for the block afterwards if
    you changed its voice — existing audio is not regenerated automatically.

voice_id.description: New TTS voice ID for this block, from list_voices; empty leaves the voice unchanged
voice_id.title: Voice Id

volume.description: Playback volume for this block, 0-1; omit to leave unchanged
volume.title: Volume

name: update_voice_block
title: Update voice block
